intended_application: Run a limited fleet charging trial that exports power to the grid while reserving charge for daily routes.
organization: A hypothetical regional delivery fleet with the same technical trial access.
business_need: Consider the same trial under lower willingness to accept uncertainty.
capabilities_constraints: Same written pilot permission and compatible trial hardware as primary; organization will not expose route vehicles until warranty and commercial terms are documented.
risk_consequence_context: Unexpected discharge could prevent a scheduled delivery.
management_question: Should this organization adopt, experiment with, monitor, defer, or reject this emerging technology for this application at this time?
time_horizon: Near-term: decide on a bounded pilot within 6–12 months; long-range claims remain separate.
additional_context:
